description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Foreign Exchange Act,No.12 2017, Order Under Section 22
reasoning: This gazette content is an order issued under Section 22 of the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017, which establishes regulatory limits on foreign currency transactions and overseas investments. It creates new financial regulations and compliance requirements, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural announcement. The mention of Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe is incidental to his authority to issue such regulatory orders under the Act.
